faq.title: Important questions deserve clear answers
faq.body: Short answers to help you choose your next step with confidence.

items.title: Does Darb guarantee admission or a visa?
items.description: No. Darb professionally prepares and follows the file, while admissions and visa decisions remain solely with universities and the responsible authorities.

items.title: How much does the service cost?
items.description: It depends on your profile and the services required. After assessment, you receive a clear written breakdown before any commitment.

items.title: Do I pay through the website?
items.description: No. The website processes no payments. Agreements, signatures, and payment take place in person at the Darb office.

items.title: What is the first step?
items.description: Request a profile assessment or contact us on WhatsApp. We will explain what information is needed and the most suitable next step.

final.title: You do not need to know the whole route today
final.body: Send your details so we can understand your profile, or speak with us directly on WhatsApp. We will help you identify the right first step.

languagePrep.title: German becomes a clear progression
languagePrep.body: Build the language level, take the right exam, then move toward the academic route that fits your profile.

A1.label: A1 · Breakthrough
A1.description: Can understand and use very familiar everyday expressions and simple phrases. You can introduce yourself, share basic personal information, and communicate simply when the other person speaks clearly and slowly.

A2.label: A2 · Elementary
A2.description: Can understand frequently used expressions about everyday needs and familiar topics. You can handle simple routine exchanges and describe your immediate environment in simple terms.

B1.label: B1 · Intermediate
B1.description: Can understand the main points of clear standard language on familiar topics. You can manage many everyday and travel situations and produce connected speech about experiences, plans and familiar subjects.

B2.label: B2 · Upper intermediate
B2.description: Can understand the main ideas of complex texts and discussions, including topics related to your field. You can interact with greater fluency and explain viewpoints with clear, detailed language.

C1.label: C1 · Advanced / Academic
C1.description: Can understand demanding, longer texts and recognise implicit meaning. You can communicate fluently and flexibly for social, academic and professional purposes and produce clear, well-structured language on complex topics.

languagePrep.levelMeaningLabel: What you can do at this level
languagePrep.cefrNote: Based on the Council of Europe CEFR global scale. These are learner-friendly summaries, not an exam guarantee.

telc.label: telc · Registration support

TestDaF.description: We can help you plan your TestDaF route, coordinate registration with the relevant centre and prepare for the exam stage.

TestAS.label: TestAS · Registration support
TestAS.description: We can help you understand when TestAS is relevant, coordinate the registration steps and prepare your application timeline.

onSET.label: onSET · Language assessment
onSET.description: We can guide you on using onSET as a language-level assessment when it fits your route and explain the next step.

DSH.label: DSH · University entrance exam
DSH.description: We can explain when DSH preparation may fit your university route and help you plan the registration steps with the relevant institution.

Goethe.description: We can help you identify the level you need, compare suitable options and plan the certificate stage.

IELTS.label: IELTS · English language test
IELTS.description: We can help you understand when an English certificate is relevant to your route and organize the next steps.

TOEFL.label: TOEFL · English language test
TOEFL.description: We can help you check whether TOEFL fits the requirement and plan the test stage within your application timeline.
